fullTextZH: 哈喽，我是来自台湾的西卡。
fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 你上次坐飞机是什么时候？
fullTextEN: When was the last time you flew?

fullTextZH: 我以前我不讨厌坐飞机。
我坐飞机的时候可以看电影，
fullTextEN: When I fly, I can watch movies,
I think flying is no problem, okay.

fullTextZH: 我每次坐飞机都很头痛，
fullTextEN: Every time I fly, I get a headache,

fullTextZH: 因为现在我有一个小孩
fullTextEN: Because now I have a child

fullTextZH: 我坐飞机的时候最害怕什么呢？
fullTextEN: What am I most afraid of when flying?
I am most afraid of my child crying.
When he cries, it's very noisy,

fullTextZH: 很吵。我很害怕别的人会生气，
fullTextEN: Very noisy. I'm afraid others will get angry,
and scold me, scold my child.

fullTextZH: 所以我现在不喜欢坐飞机。
fullTextEN: So now I don't like flying.

fullTextZH: 有一次，我和我的先生、小孩，
fullTextEN: Once, my husband, child, and I,
We flew from Taiwan to Japan,

fullTextZH: 那个时候我的小孩差不多一岁。
fullTextEN: At that time, my child was about one year old.

fullTextZH: 这不是他第一次坐飞机，
fullTextEN: It wasn't his first time flying,

fullTextZH: 没问题。还好，他在飞机上可以睡觉。
fullTextEN: No problem. Luckily, he could sleep on the plane.

fullTextZH: 我的小孩在飞机上睡觉了吗？
fullTextEN: Did my child sleep on the plane?
The more he cried, the louder he got.

fullTextZH: 飞机上全部都是他的声音。
fullTextEN: The plane was filled with his noise.

fullTextZH: 我和我的先生非常紧张，
fullTextEN: My husband and I were very nervous,
because our child was very noisy.
We gave him food and drinks,

fullTextZH: 所以我们抱小孩去厕所那里站着。
fullTextEN: so we held the child and stood by the restroom.
The flight attendant also wanted to help us,
They gave ice cubes for the child to play with,
but he didn't want them either.

fullTextZH: 我的先生和我一样，脸很红，
fullTextEN: My husband and I are the same, our faces are very red,
We don't know what to do.

fullTextZH: 最后，我的孩子想睡觉了，
fullTextEN: Finally, my child wanted to sleep,

fullTextZH: 那个时候我们才回去座位。
fullTextEN: Only then did we return to our seats.
I didn't dare to look at others,

fullTextZH: 我觉得全部的人都在生气。
我旁边的人是一个很年轻的女孩，
fullTextEN: The person next to me was a very young girl,

fullTextZH: 可是我回去座位的时候，
fullTextEN: but when I returned to my seat,

fullTextZH: 她帮我拿走椅子上的东西，
fullTextEN: She helped me remove things from the chair,
he gave me a bottle of juice,

fullTextZH: 他说：“这个给你的小孩喝。”
fullTextEN: he said, "This is for your child to drink."

fullTextZH: 他看起来也没有不高兴，
没关系，小孩哭是正常的，没问题。”
fullTextEN: It's okay, it's normal for kids to cry, no problem.'
At that time, I felt like crying a bit,

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得这些人真好。
fullTextEN: because I thought these people were really nice.

fullTextZH: 很吵，可是他们没有生气，
fullTextEN: very noisy, but they weren't angry,

fullTextZH: 我想没有人喜欢听到小孩哭，
fullTextEN: I think no one likes to hear children cry,

fullTextZH: 可是那一次，飞机上的人很有爱心。
fullTextEN: But that time, the people on the plane were very kind.

fullTextZH: 他们知道带小孩坐飞机很难，
fullTextEN: They knew it was hard to fly with children,
so I was very grateful to them.
How about you? When you fly,
Please leave a message and tell me.
